base: black line under masking tape, liquid clear on the sides, liquid white in the middle

steps.subject: other: wood grain side strips
steps.action: paint brown side strips
steps.load: equal parts sap green and alizarin crimson for a brown
steps.rule: transparent colors work a little better

steps.subject: other: wood grain side strips
steps.action: paint the other side strip blue-grey
steps.motion: paint along the other side strip

steps.subject: other: wood grain side strips
steps.action: pull a thinner-dipped fan brush to make grain
steps.load: fan dipped in paint thinner, shaken
steps.rule: thinner and liquid clear react to make the grain

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: criss-cross phthalo blue sky
steps.where: upper sky, this side of the tape
steps.rule: keep the blue out of the wood grain area

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: tap a little cloud with the corner

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend the clouds lightly

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: knife a far-away mountain in dark mix with white
steps.motion: cut a roll on the knife edge
steps.rule: keeps busy while the wood grain effect works

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: knife the big dark mountain
steps.motion: roll on knife edge and place the peak

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: pull the 2in edge up to lighten the bottom
steps.motion: grab firmly and pull up to the edge
steps.rule: removes excess paint so the bottom looks lighter

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: warm white highlight on the mountain
steps.load: white with the least bright red
steps.rule: a hint of red warms the white

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: lighter projection on the mountain
steps.load: white with a little phthalo blue

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: dark shadow under the projection
steps.motion: lay a shadow under the projection
steps.rule: each highlight needs its own shadow to work

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: tap the base then pull upward
steps.motion: tap the base and pull gently upward
steps.rule: removes tap marks and makes mist at the base

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: drop in a second mountain at the base
steps.rule: a new plane in front adds depth

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: white highlights on the mountain

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: tap and blend the ranges together

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: tap a dark evergreen with the corner
steps.where: a small spot near the mountain

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: drop in a small hill at the mountain base
steps.rule: covers the base of the mountain

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: lift up for distant trees

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: pull color down for a reflection

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: add a liquid white water line

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: pull the big brush straight down for reflections
steps.motion: touch, pull straight down, then across

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: paint a big tree over the mountain with thinned mix
steps.rule: thin paint slides over thick paint without mixing

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: pull the big brush through color for bushes

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: dab white and dark sienna trunks
steps.load: white with a little dark sienna

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: highlight the big tree with fan through yellow
steps.load: fan with the dark mix pulled through yellow
steps.rule: too much highlight vanishes so keep it light

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: pick out bushes with the 1in in green
steps.motion: pull a curve up to the top

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: drop a small reflection in the water
steps.rule: does not need to be perfect since it gets blended after

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: soften the reflection with a clean brush

steps.subject: land
steps.action: dab soil and sticks in brown

steps.subject: other: black divider line
steps.action: paint a black line dividing the wood strips
